chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Ubeys ibn Hisham, from Aban, from Abu Hamza, raising it (to the Imam), said:

Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) looked at a youth who had let his garment hang low, so he said: 'O my son! Raise your garment, for it is more lasting for your clothes and more cleansing for your heart.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Title of Imam Ali)
key_terms.إِزَار: Lower garment or skirt worn by men

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and practical benefit of raising one's garment according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) links the physical act of lifting one's garment to spiritual refinement, noting that it preserves the clothing from dirt and purifies the heart from khuyarat (ostentation). This teaching reflects the Shia emphasis on the interconnection between outward appearance and inward sincerity, where modesty in dress serves as a tangible discipline for cultivating humility.
